name: Body Dysmorphic Disorder Modification of the Y-BOCS (BDD-YBOCS), Adult
directions: Clinician-administered for the past week. Use the attached item-specific anchors and inquiry prompts. Items 1–5 assess thoughts, 6–10 assess related activities, and items 11–12 assess insight and avoidance. Scores are descriptive and do not diagnose.

questions.text: Time occupied by thoughts about body defect
Interference due to thoughts about body defect
Distress associated with thoughts about body defect
Resistance against thoughts of body defect
Degree of control over thoughts about body defect
Time spent in activities related to body defect
Interference due to activities related to body defect
Distress associated with activities related to body defect
Degree of control over compulsive behavior

attribution: BDD-YBOCS adult version supplied by the user; administer with its clinician prompts and scoring instructions.
